name: Local LLM Layer
description: Foundations of the local-model layer (19s-1): an async request queue with a per-year budget and a situation cache over the advisor endpoint, fixed-schema grounding digests, and a yearly in-character Chronicle of your empire on the Galactic History screen (a plain digest when no model answers). The model never runs inside the tick and never changes the game. Includes the Event Log scenario (and with it Internal Security and the Emergent Galaxy packages; their own flags).

flags.name: llmFoundations
flags.label: Local model layer
flags.description: Queue, digests and the yearly Chronicle (needs the advisor endpoint in Settings; without a model the Chronicle is the plain digest).

flags.name: llmArchivist
flags.label: Archivist + spoken orders
flags.description: Needs the local model layer. An Ask tab on Galactic History answers questions from what your empire knows (the event log, the chronicle, the digest; plain matching records when no model answers), and an Orders tab turns a typed order into one legal command, issued only after you confirm it.
